methods.name: spatial context-guided calibration Network (SCGC-Net)
methods.summary: SCGC-Net is a deep learning network for landslide detection that integrates a Hybrid Multiscale Information Extraction (HMIE) module (combining Mamba and CNN), a Context-Aware Modulator (CAM) for adaptive semantic refinement, and a Progressive Spatial-Context Calibration Strategy (PSCCS) for precise multiscale feature fusion.
methods.verbatim: To address these key challenges, this study introduces the spatial context-guided calibration Network (SCGC-Net).

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are mentioned but not linked, and the custom code for SCGC-Net is not available via any repository or persistent link.
